purpose: Test whether the already sealed, deployment-visible v117 local BP phase shifts correspond to local propagation of the underlying density field. This is a truth-aware mechanism diagnostic, not a deployable reconstruction method.

inputs_before_truth.local_shift_source: validated v117 fixed-block phase estimates from deployment-only BP fields
inputs_before_truth.accepted_block_rule: nonzero integer shift and relative coherence improvement greater than 1e-12

truth_audit.candidate: zero-fill shifted previous local density block using the presealed v117 shift
truth_audit.metric: relative reduction of mean-centered local L2 mismatch to the current local density block

predeclared_decision.plausible: accepted blocks have positive median mismatch reduction and at least 60 percent have strictly positive reduction
predeclared_decision.failure_action: Close the local transport hypothesis for the current proxy and do not train a local-transport neural rescue model.

boundaries: Opened v111 PoolFire proxy data only.
No exact operator calls are part of this diagnostic.
A positive result is only a physical-correspondence lead; it is not warm-start, matched-accuracy, speed, memory, generalization, or real-BOST success.
